plugins.name: copilot-skills
plugins.description: Personal Copilot CLI skills. Includes review-lens: review a Rust pull request, branch, commit or working-tree diff as an autonomous AI reviewing agent that proves every correctness or behavioral finding with a failing unit test included in the comment and recommended for the permanent suite — alongside public API surface, dependencies, performance, naming, telemetry and docs — then posts a structured, AI-attributed review to the PR (GitHub review or Azure DevOps threads).
